description: Defines a DX11-specific wrapper for ID3D11View pointers used by Renderbuffers, including classes for render targets, texture render targets, and surface render targets in Direct3D 11.

classes.name: RenderTarget11
classes.description: Abstract base class for D3D11 render targets, providing interface for texture, views, and subresource management.

classes.name: TextureRenderTarget11
classes.description: Concrete class for texture-based render targets, managing D3D11 resources and providing access to texture and views.

classes.name: SurfaceRenderTarget11
classes.description: Concrete class for surface-based render targets, typically associated with swap chains, providing size and view access.

methods.name: RenderTarget11(const d3d11::Format &formatSet)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the render target with a format set.

methods.name: getFormatSet
methods.description: Returns the format set associated with the render target.

methods.name: TextureRenderTarget11(...)
methods.description: Constructor for texture render target, taking ownership of D3D11 resources.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the render target.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the render target.

methods.name: getDepth
methods.description: Returns the depth of the render target.

methods.name: getInternalFormat
methods.description: Returns the internal format of the render target.

methods.name: getSamples
methods.description: Returns the sample count of the render target.

methods.name: getShaderResourceView
methods.description: Returns the shader resource view for a given context.

methods.name: getBlitShaderResourceView
methods.description: Returns the blit shader resource view for a given context.

methods.name: SurfaceRenderTarget11(SwapChain11 *swapChain, Renderer11 *renderer, bool depth)
methods.description: Constructor for surface render target, associated with a swap chain.
